+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import requests
+
+
+@dataclass
+class IdentityConfig:
+    api_key: str

+    tenant_id: str | None = None
+    project_id: str | None = None
+    region: str | None = None
+    auth0_domain: str | None = None
+    google_client_id: str | None = None
+    google_client_secret: str | None = None
+
+
+def load_identity_config(config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    merged = {
+        "api_key": config.get("api_key") or os.environ["FIREBASE_API_KEY"],
+        "provider_id": config.get("provider_id") or os.environ.get("FIREBASE_PROVIDER_ID", "google.com"),
+        "tenant_id": config.get("tenant_id") or os.environ.get("FIREBASE_TENANT_ID"),

+    return IdentityConfig(**merged)
+
+
+def make_firebase_request(path, config, params=None, json=None, method="post"):

+import base64
+import hashlib
+import secrets
+
+import requests
+
+from identity_client import load_identity_config
+
+
+def _challenge(verifier):
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest()
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")
+
+
+def pkce_login(payload, config=None):
+    config = load_identity_config(config)
+    verifier = payload.get("code_verifier") or secrets.token_urlsafe(64)
+    challenge = _challenge(verifier)
+    auth_url = "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth"
+    query = {
+        "response_type": "code",
+        "client_id": config.google_client_id,
+        "redirect_uri": payload["redirect_uri"],
+        "scope": "openid email profile",
+        "code_challenge": challenge,
+        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
+        "access_type": "offline",
+        "prompt": "consent",
+    }
+    return {"authorization_url": requests.Request("GET", auth_url, params=query).prepare().url, "code_verifier": verifier}
+
*** End Patch
